description: An active registered device of an active admin DID authorizes an exact unexpired pending request; it need not be an old-generation leaf. Activation preserves immutable conversationKind plus every participant status/role/provenance, atomically supersedes the old generation, closes every old application interval at the reset seq, and installs the activator-only epoch-zero successor leaf. Every other participant has zero successor leaves: active participants recover through their own signed requests and pending participants remain pending. There is no reset reservation, bootstrap Commit, or Welcome. Metadata is either the same signed content/version/origin reencrypted with a fresh nonce or an activator-signed empty prior-version-plus-one snapshot.
